assertions.assert: Each element (stimulus, recognize) takes exactly its declared attributes, the required ones present and none empty, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/bot.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<bot:stimulus> writes the envelope {event, data, source, target?, id?}: event a non-empty string, source null when it evaluates to null, undefined or the empty string, and target and id included when given and not undefined; an empty event raises error.execution and assigns nothing.

<bot:recognize> writes true exactly when the name's case-folded letter-and-digit tokens appear as a whole run among the text's; a missing name or one with no tokens is never heard, and a text that is neither a string nor null raises error.execution and assigns nothing.
